[dyng/core/array_view.hpp] frozen
  template <typename value_t> class dyng::array_view
      using value_type = std::remove_cv_t< value_t >
      using element_type = value_t
      using size_type = std::size_t
      using pointer = value_t *
      using reference = value_t &
      using iterator = value_t *
      constexpr array_view() noexcept=default
      constexpr array_view(pointer data, size_type size, memory_space space=memory_space::host, int device=-1) noexcept
      template <typename other_t, typename = std::enable_if_t<std::is_const_v<value_t> && std::is_same_v<const other_t, value_t>>> constexpr array_view(const array_view< other_t > &other) noexcept
      [[nodiscard]] constexpr pointer data() const noexcept
      [[nodiscard]] constexpr size_type size() const noexcept
      [[nodiscard]] constexpr size_type size_bytes() const noexcept
      [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool empty() const noexcept
      [[nodiscard]] constexpr memory_space space() const noexcept
      [[nodiscard]] constexpr int device() const noexcept
      constexpr reference operator[](size_type i) const noexcept
      reference at(size_type i) const
      [[nodiscard]] constexpr iterator begin() const noexcept
      [[nodiscard]] constexpr iterator end() const noexcept
      [[nodiscard]] array_view subview(size_type offset, size_type count) const
  template <typename value_t> [[nodiscard]] constexpr array_view< value_t > dyng::host_view(value_t *data, std::size_t size) noexcept
  template <typename value_t, typename alloc_t> [[nodiscard]] array_view< value_t > dyng::host_view(std::vector< value_t, alloc_t > &v) noexcept
  template <typename value_t, typename alloc_t> [[nodiscard]] array_view< const value_t > dyng::host_view(const std::vector< value_t, alloc_t > &v) noexcept

  enum class dyng::cycle_count::search_method : std::uint8_t { johnson }
  enum class dyng::cycle_count::cycle_mode : std::uint8_t { simple }
  enum class dyng::cycle_count::cuda_scheduler : std::uint8_t { work_queue, naive }
  enum class dyng::cycle_count::cuda_work_items : std::uint8_t { automatic, roots, edges, two_hop }
  [[nodiscard]] std::string_view dyng::cycle_count::to_string(search_method m) noexcept
  [[nodiscard]] std::string_view dyng::cycle_count::to_string(cycle_mode m) noexcept
  [[nodiscard]] std::string_view dyng::cycle_count::to_string(cuda_scheduler s) noexcept
  [[nodiscard]] std::string_view dyng::cycle_count::to_string(cuda_work_items w) noexcept
  struct dyng::cycle_count::options
      int max_length = -1
      search_method method = search_method::johnson
      cycle_mode mode = cycle_mode::simple
      engine cuda_engine = engine::automatic
      cuda_scheduler scheduler = cuda_scheduler::work_queue
      cuda_work_items work_items = cuda_work_items::automatic
  struct dyng::cycle_count::stats : public dyng::update_stats
      apply_summary batch
      std::int64_t deletions = 0
      std::int64_t insertions = 0
      std::uint64_t cycles_removed = 0
      std::uint64_t cycles_added = 0
  #define DYNG_CYCLE_COUNT_TYPES_MESSAGE
  class dyng::cycle_count::result
      result(result &&other) noexcept
      result & operator=(result &&other) noexcept
      result(const result &)=delete
      result & operator=(const result &)=delete
      ~result()
      [[nodiscard]] array_view< const std::uint64_t > counts() const
      [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t count(std::int64_t length) const
      [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t total() const
      [[nodiscard]] std::int64_t bound() const
      [[nodiscard]] const options & get_options() const
      void set_options(const options &opt)
      [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t graph_version() const noexcept
      [[nodiscard]] memory_space space() const noexcept
      [[nodiscard]] result clone(const resources &res) const
  template <typename vertex_t, typename edge_t, typename weight_t> [[nodiscard]] result dyng::cycle_count::compute(const resources &res, const graph< vertex_t, edge_t, weight_t > &g, const options &opt={})
  template <typename vertex_t, typename edge_t, typename weight_t> stats dyng::cycle_count::update(const resources &res, graph< vertex_t, edge_t, weight_t > &g, const edge_batch_view< vertex_t, weight_t > &batch, result &r)
  detail: template <typename vertex_t, typename edge_t, typename weight_t> inline constexpr bool cycle_count_supported_v = std::is_same_v<vertex_t, std::int32_t> && (std::is_same_v<edge_t, std::int32_t> || std::is_same_v<edge_t, std::int64_t>) && (is_unweighted_v<weight_t> || std::is_same_v<weight_t, std::int32_t>);
  detail: template <> struct update_traits<cycle_count::result> { using stats_type = cycle_count::stats; }

      [[nodiscard]] bool empty() const noexcept
  template <typename vertex_t, typename weight_t> class dyng::edge_batch
      static constexpr int default_num_weights = is_unweighted_v<weight_t> ? 0 : 1
      explicit edge_batch(int num_weights=default_num_weights)
      void insert_edge(vertex_t u, vertex_t v, std::initializer_list< weight_t > weights)
      void insert_edge(vertex_t u, vertex_t v)
      void insert_edge(vertex_t u, vertex_t v, array_view< const weight_t > weights)
      void delete_edge(vertex_t u, vertex_t v)
      void reserve(std::size_t insertions, std::size_t deletions)
      void clear() noexcept
      [[nodiscard]] int num_weights() const noexcept
      [[nodiscard]] std::size_t num_insertions() const noexcept
      [[nodiscard]] std::size_t num_deletions() const noexcept
      [[nodiscard]] bool empty() const noexcept
      [[nodiscard]] const std::vector< vertex_t > & insert_src() const noexcept
      [[nodiscard]] const std::vector< vertex_t > & insert_dst() const noexcept
      [[nodiscard]] const std::vector< weight_t > & insert_weights() const noexcept
      [[nodiscard]] const std::vector< vertex_t > & delete_src() const noexcept
      [[nodiscard]] const std::vector< vertex_t > & delete_dst() const noexcept
      [[nodiscard]] edge_batch_view< vertex_t, weight_t > view() const noexcept
